scripts.db:migrate: env-cmd -f .env pnpm --filter api exec prisma migrate dev --schema=prisma/schema
scripts.db:studio: env-cmd -f .env pnpm --filter api exec prisma studio --schema=prisma/schema
scripts.db:push: env-cmd -f .env pnpm --filter api exec prisma db push --schema=prisma/schema
scripts.db:pull: env-cmd -f .env pnpm --filter api exec prisma db pull --schema=prisma/schema
scripts.db:generate: env-cmd -f .env pnpm --filter api exec prisma generate --schema=prisma/schema
